name: Gorilla Nights
summary:
Gorilla Nights a heart-pounding horror experience set in a twisted, abandoned playhouse where childhood nostalgia meets pure terror. In this game, players take on the role of gorillas navigating through dark, unsettling environments filled with eerie sounds and ominous atmospheres. The once joyful Gorilla Nights is now a haunting labyrinth of decaying rooms, hidden corners, and creaky structures, making every turn a terrifying to unknown.
